Subject: Hosted API integration - request for technical deep-dive

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for the overview last week. We'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive so our engineering team can walk through the proposed Hosted API integration. Key areas we want to cover: SDKs (server + mobile), streaming/token/cancellation behavior, and tool/function-calling patterns for our orchestration layer.

Our engineering leads (Tom Li and myself) are available on the following windows next week (PDT):
- Tue 2026-07-21: 10:30-12:00
- Wed 2026-07-22: 08:00-10:00 or 14:00-15:30
- Thu 2026-07-23: 09:00-11:00

We have an integration checklist attached that outlines our current stack and questions. Can you propose a firm slot and confirm who from your side will join?

Thanks,
Sara

Proposed slot: Tue 2026-07-21 10:30-11:30 PDT (we'll keep it to 60 minutes with a follow-up for deeper items). If that works, I'll send a calendar invite. Attendees from our side: Marissa (Solutions), Laura (SE), Dev (Platform Engineer), Vivek (Sales Engineer).

If you prefer Wed morning instead, let me know and we can shift.

Best,

Hi Sara — 10:30 on Tue works for me. Quick note: would you prefer this to be 60 or 90 minutes? Given the function-calling examples and auth nuances (token scoping, service-to-service), I recommend 75–90 minutes if you have it.

Agenda suggestion (60–90 min):
- 5 min intros & goals
- 15 min hosted API overview + SDKs (what we ship vs community SDKs)
- 20–30 min streaming & cancellation behavior (live demo)
- 15–20 min function/tool calling patterns & security model (examples + JSON schemas)
- 10 min integration checklist Q&A / next steps

If 60 is all you have, we can prioritize streaming + function-calling and follow up with a recorded deep-dive for SDKs.

Laura Bennett

Sara — quick tech note ahead of the call. For function/tool calling, it helps if we know:
- whether you'll be invoking backend tools (EHR queries, billing lookups) from the model or orchestrating from your middleware
- expected max token lengths and typical prompt composition (we saw issues with prompts > 4k tokens in some early integrations)

I've added a short repo of examples (function-calling JSON schemas + streaming client snippets) here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dev-redwood-examples. We'll demo the Node streaming client and a Python function-calling flow that returns structured JSON.

If you can drop a short note in reply describing the orchestration pattern, I can prepare tailored examples.

Thanks — see you on Tue.

—Dev

Marissa / team — thanks for the options and the diagram. Apologies for the delay — we needed to align on Tom's schedule. Tue 2026-07-21 10:30 PDT won't work anymore; can we move to Wed 2026-07-22 08:30–10:00 PDT? That gives us 90 minutes.

Tom will lead the integration questions; our orchestration pattern is: middleware-driven orchestration where the model is allowed to call backend tools (EHR query + patient-data fetch) but all calls are proxied through our middleware for audit. Typical prompts are 1–2k tokens; occasional longer history up to ~6k tokens. We'll whitelist the examples you demo.

Confirming attachments received. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Sara
